lede: The most consequential meeting this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission on August 13, where commissioners take up both a subdivision work session and a referral on an energy code update that would reshape building standards for new construction across the county. Ridgway's Town Council also has a full plate on August 12, including a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision replatting and a joint work session on a draft Housing Action Plan required under state law. Running alongside all of it is Telluride Mushroom Festival, filling venues from the Sheridan Opera House to the Alibi through the week.
